headline: Graded cards, bought and sold in one place
intro: Buy slabs outright from the store, or bid on the ones that only come up once. One Grade10 account carries your profile, your orders, and your bids.
storeBody: Every slab in the store is listed at a fixed price with its grade on the tile.
auctionsTagline: Open to anyone, no account needed.
auctionsBody: Browse every published sale and its listings. Sign in when you are ready to bid.
profileBody: Sign in with a magic link or a code — no password to keep.
